test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight family members M, N, O, P, Q, R, T, and U are going to a marriage party. They all sit around a circular table for dinner facing center but not necessarily in the same order. O sits third to the right of M. Q sits opposite to O. U sits opposite to T. N sits third to the left of Q. P sits second to the left of M. R. sits immediate right to T. Who sits immediate right of N?
solution: Given: Eight family members M, N, O, P, Q, R, T, and U. 1) O sits third to the right of M. 2) Q sits opposite to O. 3) P sits second to the left of M.
